California Consumer Privacy Notice

Effective date: January 2025

Last updated: June 2026

This California Consumer Privacy Notice (“Notice”) supplements National Opinion Institute’s (“National Opinion Institute”) Privacy Policy and applies solely to the personal information collected online and offline of California consumers.
